statements.__comment: Only projects no sync has written for 24h (86400s; lastupdated is a sync start time, reused across a paginated run) are swept, so a project another worker has just written and not yet linked survives.
statements.query: MATCH (p:GitLabProject) WHERE NOT (p)<-[:RESOURCE]-() AND coalesce(p.lastupdated, 0) < $UPDATE_TAG - 86400 WITH p LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[br:BRANCH]->(b:GitLabBranch) DELETE br, b WITH DISTINCT p DELETE p return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

name: orphan sweep of GitLabProject nodes no group links to, with their branches
